metadata.description: 20-prompt balanced suite: 10 should trigger, 10 should not trigger. Non-triggering prompts are deliberately adjacent boundary cases (pricing estimation, mortgage calculation, general home improvements, general mechanical CAD, 3D gaming level layouts) to evaluate boundary precision.

cases.prompt: Extract the floor plan for 123 Maple Street from Zillow.
Generate a CAD floor plan from the Zillow listing at 742 Evergreen Terrace.
Can you research real estate floor plans for the Apartments.com community at 'Westside Apartments'?
Convert the Redfin blueprint for 456 Oak Ave to a DXF file.
Draw a floor plan with Floor Builder MCP for a 2B2B layout.
Use Redfin MCP to get property listing floor plan media and convert to SVG.
Query Apartments.com for studio floor plans and build CAD vector geometry.
I want to snap adjacent walls in my real estate layout and generate a DXF of it.
Create a layered CAD layout following AIA guidelines for 1001 Pine Street.
Run validation on this floor plan spec JSON to check closed loop boundaries and egress clearances.
Estimate the property value or market price for 123 Maple Street.
How much will my monthly mortgage payment be for a $500,000 home loan?
Suggest some general home improvements and landscaping ideas for a small backyard.
Design a 3D mechanical CAD model for a custom engine piston.
Draft a 3D video game level layout for an arena shooter.
Help me design a database schema for real estate listing transactions.
Find open house listings near Seattle for this weekend.
How do I negotiate a lease agreement with my landlord?
Write a Python script to scrape property prices from real estate websites.
Draw a mechanical gear schematic using AutoCAD commands.

evals.prompt: Extract the floor plan for 123 Maple Street from Zillow.

assertions.text: Skill activates on Zillow floor plan extraction request
Correctly routes to Stage 1 discovery

evals.prompt: Generate a CAD floor plan from the Zillow listing at 742 Evergreen Terrace.

assertions.text: Skill activates on CAD generation from Zillow listing
Identifies the need for Floor Builder and CAD MCP servers

evals.prompt: Can you research real estate floor plans for the Apartments.com community at 'Westside Apartments'?

assertions.text: Skill activates on Apartments.com floor plan research
Understands unit models instead of individual physical units

evals.prompt: Convert the Redfin blueprint for 456 Oak Ave to a DXF file.

assertions.text: Skill activates on Redfin blueprint conversion to DXF
Triggers CAD/BIM MCP server to output DXF format

evals.prompt: Draw a floor plan with Floor Builder MCP for a 2B2B layout.

assertions.text: Skill activates on Floor Builder MCP drawing request
Utilizes floor-builder-mcp-server toolchain

evals.prompt: Use Redfin MCP to get property listing floor plan media and convert to SVG.

assertions.text: Skill activates on Redfin MCP media extraction and SVG conversion
Schedules Stage 1 discovery and Stage 2 CAD authoring

evals.prompt: Query Apartments.com for studio floor plans and build CAD vector geometry.

assertions.text: Skill activates on Apartments.com studio query for CAD build
Recognizes Apartments.com MCP tool get_community_floorplans

evals.prompt: I want to snap adjacent walls in my real estate layout and generate a DXF of it.

assertions.text: Skill activates on snapping adjacent walls and exporting DXF
Recognizes correct ordering: snap_adjacent_walls before portal insertion

evals.prompt: Create a layered CAD layout following AIA guidelines for 1001 Pine Street.

assertions.text: Skill activates on creating AIA CAD layers
Asserts adherence to AIA CAD layer guidelines (A-WALL, A-DOOR, etc.)

evals.prompt: Run validation on this floor plan spec JSON to check closed loop boundaries and egress clearances.

assertions.text: Skill activates on running validation
Triggers validate_geometric_closure.py script

evals.prompt: Estimate the property value or market price for 123 Maple Street.

assertions.text: Skill rejects property price estimation request

evals.prompt: How much will my monthly mortgage payment be for a $500,000 home loan?

assertions.text: Skill rejects mortgage calculation request

evals.prompt: Suggest some general home improvements and landscaping ideas for a small backyard.

assertions.text: Skill rejects general home improvements request

evals.prompt: Design a 3D mechanical CAD model for a custom engine piston.

assertions.text: Skill rejects mechanical CAD model request

evals.prompt: Draft a 3D video game level layout for an arena shooter.

assertions.text: Skill rejects 3D video game level design request

evals.prompt: Help me design a database schema for real estate listing transactions.

assertions.text: Skill rejects general database design coding request

evals.prompt: Find open house listings near Seattle for this weekend.

assertions.text: Skill rejects general open house/listing search

evals.prompt: How do I negotiate a lease agreement with my landlord?

assertions.text: Skill rejects legal or lease agreement requests

evals.prompt: Write a Python script to scrape property prices from real estate websites.

assertions.text: Skill rejects general web scraping requests

evals.prompt: Draw a mechanical gear schematic using AutoCAD commands.

assertions.text: Skill rejects general mechanical CAD requests
